heroabout.title: A small studio making homes that fit their people
heroabout.text: Hiên Studio began at a drawing table in a rented house in 2012. Fourteen years on we still measure by hand and meet every client at least three times before drawing the first line.

herocontact.title: Book a home survey
herocontact.text: Call 0903 000 111 or send an email and we will set a date to measure, during working hours. The first survey is free.

process.title: Survey (week 1)
process.text: We visit, measure every room, photograph what is there and ask how each person lives. You receive the survey and a needs list.

process.title: Options (weeks 2 to 4)
process.text: Two floor-plan options with renders, refined until the whole family agrees. You receive a 1:50 plan and 3D views.

process.title: Build (weeks 5 to 14)
process.text: The studio's own crew works in your home, with a photo log every week. You receive a weekly site journal.

process.title: Handover (week 15)
process.text: We check each item with you, fix issues on the spot and start the 24-month warranty. You receive completion records and a warranty card.
